label: Mr. Burns
description: An ancient tycoon who assumed Smithers would be doing this.
direction: Speak as a frail, ancient, sinister tycoon: thin, reedy, slow, relishing every word, with old-fashioned diction and quiet menace. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model not yet chosen: `voice` is the placeholder "TBD" until the voice-selection pass names one. The menace and the antique vocabulary sit on greetings, alerts and arrival; turns stay plain.

rights.author: 20th Television / The Walt Disney Company (character created by Matt Groening)
rights.pd_basis: None. The series and character are in copyright and trademarked. Christopher Collins first voiced the character in 1989; Harry Shearer has performed it for nearly the whole run and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Harry Shearer's.

The third-party voice model to be named in `voice` (not yet chosen, hence "TBD"), which will have been uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Do hurry it along.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Time is money.
lines.start_drive_1: Ahoy hoy! Smithers, start the motorcar.
lines.start_drive_3: Who is this driver, Smithers? Never mind. Drive.
lines.start_drive_4: Fire up the horseless carriage. Time is money.
lines.start_drive_6: Onward, chauffeur. And mind the peasants.
lines.start_drive_7: I shall navigate. You shall obey. Splendid.
lines.start_drive_8: Smithers usually does this. Very well, proceed.
lines.start_drive_9: To the plant! Or wherever common folk go.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Smithers, who is this buffoon?
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Smithers, I am dizzy.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Go around, and do not gawk.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Smithers, deal with it.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down. I detest fines.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Regrettably.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Smile, Smithers. Look law abiding.
lines.reroute_chime: You missed the turn. Simpson, eh? New route.
